title: License Key Formatting
description: You are given a license key string `s` consisting of alphanumeric characters and dashes `'-'`, and a positive integer `k`. Reformat the string so that all lowercase letters are converted to uppercase, every group contains exactly `k` characters separated by `'-'`, except the first group which may be shorter than `k` (between 1 and `k` characters). If `s` has no alphanumeric characters, return `""`.
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, and dashes '-'.
hints: Iterate backward through s ignoring dashes, converting letters to uppercase.
Insert a dash before every k-th appended character (when the current group is full), then reverse at the end.

examples.explanation: Stripping dashes gives 8 characters, split into two groups of 4: "5F3Z-2E9W".
5 characters with k = 2 produce a first group of 1 followed by two groups of 2: "2-5G-3J".
No alphanumeric characters exist, so return an empty string.
